details.description: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use is a specialized preview model from Google DeepMind, built on Gemini 2.5 Pro, for agents that interact directly with graphical user interfaces. Given a screenshot, the user's goal and prior actions, it returns the next UI action -- such as a click, keystroke, scroll or drag -- which the host application executes before capturing the next screenshot, in an iterative loop. Google released it in preview in October 2025 through a computer_use tool in the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and Vertex AI. Google's current Gemini API documentation notes that Gemini 3 Pro and Flash models now include built-in computer use without a separate model, and this dedicated model no longer appears on Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page.
advantages: Reports 70%+ accuracy at about 225 seconds of latency on the Online-Mind2Web browser-control benchmark, per Google's launch blog post.
Outperforms competing computer-use models on the WebVoyager and AndroidWorld benchmarks, per Google's launch blog post.

Supports a defined set of UI actions -- click, hover, type, scroll, drag-and-drop, navigate, key combinations -- and lets developers exclude actions or add custom ones, per Google's Gemini API documentation.
Can operate behind login screens and manipulate interactive elements such as dropdowns, per Google's launch blog post.
disadvantages: Preview release, marked by a dated snapshot suffix (-10-2025) in its model id.
Uses a normalized 0-999 coordinate system that requires client-side scaling, per Google's documentation.
Limited to browser automation; desktop and mobile UI control were added only with later Gemini 3.x models, per Google's documentation.
No longer listed on Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page; Google's Gemini API docs state Gemini 3 Pro and Flash now support computer use natively, without a separate model.
use_cases: Automating multi-step browser tasks such as filling forms and navigating dropdown menus, including behind login screens
Integrated into Firebase Testing Agent and AI Mode in Search, per Google's launch blog post

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Computer Use Preview | Gemini API

notes: Exact percentage figures for the Online-Mind2Web, WebVoyager and AndroidWorld benchmarks are shown only in a chart image on Google's launch blog post and were not extractable as text; the page's own text states '70%+ accuracy, ~225 sec latency' for Online-Mind2Web, which I used verbatim rather than guessing a precise number. Google DeepMind's current Gemini model overview page (deepmind.google/models/gemini/) no longer lists this model, consistent with Gemini API docs stating Gemini 3 Pro/Flash now support computer use built in.
